name: 2023–2030 Australian Cyber Security Strategy
description: 2023–2030 Australian Cyber Security Strategy (released November 22, 2023). Australia's flagship national cyber security strategy structured around six 'cyber shields' (Strong businesses and citizens; Safe technology; World-class threat sharing and blocking; Protected critical infrastructure; Sovereign capabilities; Resilient region and global leadership) and executed across three Horizons (Horizon 1: 2023–2025, Horizon 2: 2026–2028, Horizon 3: 2029–2030).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Department of Home Affairs (homeaffairs.gov.au) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Department of Home Affairs (homeaffairs.gov.au).
